item.title: CobaltC – C 的继承者？
item.description:
📝 Literals CobaltC provides: integer literals; floating-point literals; character literals; string literals; Boolean literals; null. Compound Types CobaltC supports: structs enums tuples arrays function types managed references raw pointers generic types interface-constrained types Structs and enums are nominal types. Generic Types Generic types and functions are statically checked.
🔤 Original: CobaltC – The Successor to C?
🔗 Read more: https://strawberry9.github.io/the-wrong-memory/Appendix_06.html

item.title: Why do I lose my passion and want to do nothing?
item.description:
📝 承担更雄心勃勃的项目。我曾经考虑过可以在几天内完成的副项目，现在我更多地考虑可以在几个月内完成的项目。有了人工智能，几天就变成了几个小时，几个月就变成了几天，所以我只是试着想想以前需要我花很长时间的项目。
🔗 Read more: https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=49505014
